strategy.text: Fix the tool's own defects without touching what it rewrites: widen the scan, derive the allowlist from the same grep the gate runs. The flowchart shows scan, rename, derived gate, and the test feeding docs checks.

what-the-diff-actually-built.text: Shell and Python added to the scan, citation-line survival derived from grep output, a twice-run test with byte snapshots and a planted stray, wired into docs checks.

verification-as-shipped.text: Docs checks green including the new test, pre-fix failure at run one, weakened derivation firing the control, gate green on clean main.

file-fence-what-the-merge-touched.text: Three files: the tool, its new test, and the justfile. No model, validator, runner, docs, workflow, or check-setting edits.

slice.text: One slice: the rename gate that scans shells and derives its allowlist, shipped as a single commit.
